chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Coral Guard, then Water's Edge and All Streams Flow to the Sea at Sludge Spinner, gaining 5 Block and dealing 15 damage for all 3 Energy.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Rally the Isles followed by Coral Guard, preserving the same 5 Block while gaining 1 Charge and triggering Muster 2, but the resulting cards are unspecified and random while that line deals no immediate damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up Rally the Isles' Muster 2 and 1 Charge in exchange for 15 known damage.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Sludge Spinner had not intended to attack, I would have been more willing to replace Coral Guard and the two-attack line with Rally the Isles plus one attack, since the known value of the Block would be lower.
